# Anil Sharma — Senior Engineering & Reliability Leader

> Senior Engineering & Reliability Leader with 28+ years of continuous process experience across premier private sector petrochemical complexes and cement manufacturing. Specialist in SAE JA1011 RCM, FMEA, RCA, HT/LT power distribution, automated substation load shedding, and developer of free open-access engineering simulators.

## Who is Anil Sharma?
Anil Sharma is a Senior Engineering & Reliability Leader with India's premier private sector petrochemical and energy conglomerate, overseeing asset integrity, electrical infrastructure, automation, and capital projects. Ex-Ambuja Cements (1995–2004). SHRM Certified Facilitator, DNV GL Certified IMS Lead Auditor, and recipient of multiple corporate Best Facilitator and Top Trainer awards.

## Free Open-Access Engineering Tools (Non-Commercial Community Hobbies)
- [LiveSimulators.com](https://livesimulators.com): 65+ Float64 physics browser virtual laboratories (Power Systems, Inverters, Grid Dynamics, Electrical Safety, Rotating Machinery)
- [DesignCalculators.co.in](https://designcalculators.co.in): 150+ standardized design calculators adhering to IEC, IEEE, NFPA, NEC, and ASME codes
- [ReliabilityTools.co.in](https://reliabilitytools.co.in): 2-Parameter Weibull distribution, MTBF, MTTR, Availability modeler
- [ElectroSafe.homes](https://electrosafe.homes): Residential electrical fire prevention public good initiative
- [GitHub](https://github.com/toanilsharma): Open engineering numerical code repositories

## Core Expertise & Methodologies
- RCM (Reliability Centered Maintenance - SAE JA1011 7-Step Evaluation)
- FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) & Criticality Ranking
- Root Cause Analysis (RCA & 5-Whys Investigations)
- Total Productive Maintenance (TPM)
- Zero-Breakdown Operations Mindset
- Substation Automation & PLC Automated High-Speed Load Shedding (220kV to 6.6kV)
- Arc Flash Risk Mitigation per NFPA 70E / IEEE 1584
- E&I (Electrical & Instrumentation) Lifecycle Governance

## Corporate Training & Mentorship Track Record
Conducted 2,500+ hours of training across both interactive online virtual classrooms and hands-on plant workshops, upskilling over 200+ graduate engineers and working professionals across 14 verified disciplines:
